name: Sheet-pan dinner
intro: One vegetable, one protein, one pan, a hot oven. Sausage or pork tenderloin both work; the flavor you finish with decides which dinner it is.
season_anchor: Chicken sausage, or a whole pork tenderloin
Kabocha wedges, or sweet potato in cubes

variations.context: The default. Ajvar and lemon over everything.
Sliced thick over the squash, torn dates and feta on top.
Chile-garlic oil poured over at the table, lime squeezed hard.

finish: Heat the oven to 425°F. Squash and peppers go on the pan first, oiled and salted, with room between the pieces. Sausage goes in with them for about 30 minutes, turned once. A pork tenderloin, salted and oiled, joins the pan for the last 20 to 25 minutes — take it out when the center is still blushing pink (145°F if you have a thermometer) and let it rest five minutes before slicing. Finish with one of October's flavors.
